purpose: Same-origin Next route that proxies customer login to SHRESTA-BE and stores the returned opaque session token in an HTTP-only cookie.
securityRules: The session token is never exposed to React components after login.
The cookie is HTTP-only, SameSite=Lax, path=/, and Secure in production builds.
Profile reads and logout calls are delegated to SHRESTA-BE with a bearer token.
errorHandlingRules: All ShrestaApiError messages are passed through toShrestaUserMessage() — internal infrastructure codes (INVALID_ENVELOPE, EMPTY_DATA) become a generic user-friendly string; BE-originated codes pass through unchanged.
5xx ShrestaApiErrors are returned as 503 (not the raw BE status) so the browser never sees a 500.
ShrestaApiUnavailableError (BE unreachable or not found) returns 503 with 'Login is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.'
Malformed request JSON returns 400 with a customer-friendly message, not a raw JSON parse error string.
